verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live, structured llms.txt at bun.com/llms.txt that links to markdown doc pages, and a markdown docs root at bun.com/docs.md. Individual doc pages are also served as .md URLs (e.g. pm/cli/add.md, pm/cli/install.md), so an agent can ingest them directly. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs, and evidence of agent-specific guidance (e.g. llms-full.txt or agent usage instructions).
